title: Certificates of Deposit: When a Renewal Becomes Owed, the Renewal Date and the Dates of the New Term
content:
For Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit, the renewal that follows a grace period has a definite moment at which it becomes owed, a fixed renewal date, and a definite pair of dates for the new term. This page settles all three.

## The moment the renewal becomes owed

A renewal becomes owed once two facts hold together on the certificate record:

- the certificate's status is still the grace period status; and
- the number of days elapsed since the maturity date, with its following day as day 1, exceeds the tier's grace days.

Put as dates: the renewal is owed from the date that lies the grace days plus one day after the maturity date, and on every later date for as long as the certificate still shows the grace period status. Up to and including the last grace day, no renewal is owed.

A certificate that has already left the grace period status, whether closed by an action in grace or already back in active status, is not renewed again under this rule.

## The renewal date

Every renewal has one renewal date: the first day of the new term, which is the old maturity date. That holds however the renewal comes about, whether the owner books it while grace is running, the bank books it on the day after grace ends, or the booking happens on some later day. The day on which the renewal is actually booked is never the renewal date.

## Dates of the new term

- The new term starts on the old maturity date, whatever the day of booking.
- It matures the tier's number of calendar months after that start date. Where that later month has no day with the same number, the maturity date is the last day of that month.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical: maturity date 15 June 2026, ten grace days assumed)

| Date under review | Day count after maturity | Status on record | Renewal owed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 June 2026 | 10 | grace period | No; the last grace day |
| 26 June 2026 | 11 | grace period | Yes |
| 3 July 2026 | 18 | grace period | Yes; the lapse of time does not cancel it |
| 26 June 2026 | 11 | closed during grace | No |

In each of the owed cases above the renewal date is 15 June 2026, even when the booking is made on 3 July 2026.

## New-term dates (hypothetical)

| Old maturity date | Months in the new tier's term | New term start date | New maturity date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 June 2026 | 18 | 15 June 2026 | 15 December 2027 |
| 31 August 2026 | 6 | 31 August 2026 | 28 February 2027, the last day of that February |
| 29 February 2028 | 12 | 29 February 2028 | 28 February 2029 |
